comparison_contract: Every cell uses the same source archive, instance type, dimensions, group bounds, raw-sample schema, full inserted-vector point-visibility check, and one exhaustive exact-recall probe. A writer-count/repetition cohort is identical across the paired 2K and 16K cell counts and deliberately distinct from other writer counts to prevent equal-vector ID ties in the persistent index. Cell count and concurrent producer count are the only matrix factors. Five repetitions are mandatory; no incomplete CSV is eligible for inspection.
